title: Ascent through the seven hekhalot in Enoch and Merkavah texts

tellings.quote: The Book of Enoch and the Merkavah texts of ancient Jewish mystics describe an ascent through seven hekhalot, also called palaces, via the use of breathing techniques, visualization, and mantra-like prayers.

plain: Ancient Jewish mystics described climbing through seven heavenly palaces, called hekhalot, using breathing techniques, visualisation and prayers repeated like mantras. Michels tells this himself, drawing on the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish religious text he cites in the translation by R. H. Charles, and on the Merkavah texts, writings of early Jewish mystics about visions of God's throne-chariot. He brings it up in an episode about the idea that we live in a hologram.
